svg.text: Lambda Web Functions (Express.js) behind CloudFront + OAC
A plain Express.js server runs as a Lambda Web Function: no API Gateway, no adapter, no handler. The IamAuth endpoint only accepts requests that CloudFront signs (OAC).
Resource policy: cloudfront.amazonaws.com → lambda:InvokeWebFunctionEndpoint (aws:SourceArn = this distribution)
